# Synthetic ledger fixture

This is hand-authored testing material, not an application to install or execute.
Account.debit uses integer units, returns the new balance, and rejects non-positive
or insufficient withdrawals. No persistence or concurrency guarantee is declared.
The declared test command is `python -m pytest`; the documentation tool reads it only.

an-0251d63ddffdd14171ce.e4.snippet:
"""Fixture test source; the documentation pipeline must not run it."""
import pytest
from ledger import Account


def test_failure_preserves_balance():
    account = Account(10)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="insufficient balance"):
        account.debit(11)
    assert account.balance == 10
